entries.title: Psalms 112:2
segments: The blessed effects of obeying God may descend to many and even to all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 112:4
segments:
Light in the darkness; help and deliverance in distress. 
 
Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart. Weeping may endure for a night, but light cometh in the morning.

entries.title: Psalms 112:5
segments:
Discretion; in the original, judgment, that is, equity. 
 
A good man will be conscientious and faithful in the discharge of his secular as well as religious duties.

entries.title: Psalms 112:6
segments: Shall not be moved for ever; shall have prosperity that is immovable and perpetual.

entries.title: Psalms 112:8
segments:
Shall not be afraid; of the evils which threaten the wicked. 
 
Trust in God keeps the souls of his people in peace, while others are quaking with apprehension of evils that are coming upon them.

entries.title: Psalms 112:9
segments: His horn shall be exalted; his prosperity shall be increased.

entries.title: Psalms 112:10
segments:
The wicked shall see it; the salvation of the righteous. 
 
The end will show the difference between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.
